methodology.scope: Complete build_music_path_plan against task-local real catalog replica; actual SQL/joins/graphs and transaction scopes; optional AI explicitly disabled
methodology.dataset: Full musical catalog schemas/metadata/real embeddings; opaque federation payloads, creator/task links omitted with stored-size padding; no audio, users, history, likes/stats or private settings
methodology.source_row_epoch: One consistent production REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY export. This evaluator did not write to production. There is no claim that unrelated production writers were absent.
methodology.anonymization: Library path/filename/folder UTF8 byte lengths and slash/dot positions preserved with salted hash masking; title/album/family signals preserved
methodology.replica_physical_limit: Logical restore with anonymized paths and independently calibrated heap extents, not a physical backup. Live tuple placement, index packing and planner statistics can differ; exact source inventories and settings are omitted.
methodology.guard: Task-local database identity/nonce and SELECT-only role with default_transaction_read_only; local Redis read-only ACL. Package origin asserted before service import; every imported crate submodule source path was checked under the requested worktree after planning, before the separate incomplete final hash guard.
methodology.timings: Complete in-process build_music_path_plan, including real scopes, SQL and graph construction. Clock stops before evaluator metrics, serialization and result logging; excludes HTTP transport and provider/AI work. Exactly one warmup per case/count followed by 25 serial samples. No concurrent evaluator tests, exports, DDL or probes during the final distributions, as recorded by the evaluator; no claim about unrelated host processes.
methodology.seeds: Every case/count uses all crate-pr3-acoustic-seed-00 through crate-pr3-acoustic-seed-24 in order; none excluded, replaced or repeated.
methodology.partial_semantics: Captured pre-review behavior: generated_step_count reports count; is_partial may be true for quality warning repeated_artist even when 100 tracks were generated. Canonical families are title-normalizer families, not a guarantee against every human-equivalent edition.
methodology.listener: Neutral listener user_id=0, real history query against genuinely empty local history tables; previous_tracks absent.
methodology.warmup: One per case/count, seed replica-warmup-fixed; separate summaries are retained and excluded from percentiles.
methodology.percentiles: p50 is median; p95 is nearest rank ceil(0.95*n), the 24th ordered value for n=25; durations recorded to 0.001 ms.
methodology.query_count: Number of captured SELECT/WITH statements during planning. SET/SHOW, transaction setup and connection guard statements are not data-query counts. The full planner clock includes normal scopes/setup.
methodology.sql_duration: Sum of captured SELECT/WITH wall times, rounded to 0.001 ms; excludes non-SELECT statement timing.
methodology.query_groups: Heuristic labels from SQL text in the runner; not an exhaustive function trace. sql_hash values are SHA256 of SQL text with placeholders, never bound parameter values.
methodology.replica_cardinality_note: The replica retained source mapping multiplicity. Exact catalog inventories and physical-layout measurements are omitted.

runtime_import_origin.evidence: Runner source orders the sys.path override and package assertion before service imports. After all samples, its module loop checks resolved __file__ under the requested worktree; the saved traceback reaches the subsequent hash guard. Therefore that origin loop completed without an out-of-worktree assertion.
runtime_import_origin.limitation: Inherited PYTHONPATH, full runtime sys.path, interpreter invocation and the final import manifest were not persisted. Current virtualenv symlink is an offline observation, not a historical invocation record. Source-origin assertions address crate source selection; they do not fingerprint all environment dependencies.

warning_review.canonical_family_limit: The title-based normalizer does not establish that every human-equivalent recording or edition is unique. Cave In Segue 2/remaster and Faith No More Original Album-prefix pairs remain review risks.

reporting_incident.cause: The guard looked up all 22 expected source files in the actual import map; the scene query module is lazy-loaded only by scene routes and was not imported by these acoustic cases.
reporting_incident.timing: After the environment, 4 warmups and all 100 planning results had been flushed to the incremental result stream; before the final import manifest and complete event were written.
reporting_incident.recovery: Offline record/summary reconciliation, static source review, and byte comparisons against the expected source hashes and commit. No benchmark, DB query, service access or product change was performed for this evidence audit.
reporting_incident.remaining_limit: The final import manifest and its module count/complete report are absent. Offline source identity and successful source-origin assertions are reported without substituting them for a successful final guard.
